findings.evidence: The rank calculations invoke rank-nullity but the item's deps provide only the incidence-map definition, the surface Euler-characteristic corollary, and AC. They do not supply finite-dimensional rank-nullity. Add an exact supplier such as cor-matrix-rank-nullity or prove these rank identities locally.

The claimed dimension 2^{|E|-r} follows by equating the trace of the orthogonal projection Π with its rank and by using the trace formula for tensor products. The item's cited facts and earlier steps do not state or prove these identities; the finite-local-algebra definition supplies a trace definition and basis-independence, not these formulas. Supply finite-dimensional trace arguments or exact mathematical suppliers.

The proof assigns excitation counts to a joint eigenvector of the finite family of commuting self-adjoint stabilizers. The dependencies and earlier steps establish self-adjointness and commutation, but not a simultaneous eigenbasis. Prove simultaneous diagonalization, for example by induction using invariant eigenspaces, or cite an exact supplier.

The proof derives dim H_1(K_L; F_2)=2 from ranks of the incidence maps using rank-nullity and the dimension formula for a finite-dimensional quotient. Its only dependency defines the toric incidence maps and connected graphs; it supplies neither linear-algebra result. Add exact suppliers or prove the finite rank and quotient-dimension calculations locally.

F1 attributes the claim that X(a)Z(b) is a Pauli basis to def-qsmx-toric-cellular-hamiltonian, but that definition only defines these operators. Step 1.2 needs every operator on the supported edge algebra to expand in this family. Prove that I, X, Z, XZ form a basis of M_2(C) and tensor this basis over the finite support, or cite an exact supplier.
